node.statement: Write Z=[Z_{ij}]. By the standard matrix amplification in the contract, (Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z) is the block operator [Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_{ij})] from the n-fold Hilbert direct sum of S_{R,Q} to that of S_{P,Q}. Therefore its Hilbert-space adjoint has (i,j) block Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_{ji})^dagger.
